title: Code 1-3: reproducible diagnostic-band identification of field microplastics and naming divergence across six spectral-library streams
description: Executed notebooks (Code 1-3, outputs preserved in every cell) and the data products cited in several sections of the manuscript. Code 1 builds the Raman diagnostic-band reference; Code 2 the in-house FT-IR spec_class library and OMNIC record; Code 3 the naming-divergence comparison across six labelling streams.
